generationInputs.prompt: A vintage 3D snark poster logo features a luminous pink donut with female legs, an eggplant, a banana, a red chili, and a green chili, all rendered with a holographic effect. The central element is a luminous pink donut, seemingly weightless, from which two female legs emerge, clad in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes. Two hands extend from the donut, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other holding a glass pipe. To the left of the donut, an eggplant is depicted holding a syringe. To the right, a banana is also holding a glowing syringe. Below these elements, a banana, a red chili, and a green chili are arranged. The overall style is a vintage 3D snark poster logo with a dreamlike, slightly otherworldly quality due to the holographic effect of the donut's icing. The background is a soft dark pink, complementing the colors of the subjects.
